slides.title: Why we changed the release process
slides.text: Every release used to wait for one person to approve it by hand. Releases now run from one workflow that checks the same gates every time, records what it published and stops on the first failure. The change removed the queue, not the review: every pull request is still read before it merges.

slides.title: A title long enough to wrap across two lines on a standard widescreen slide
slides.text: A short body under a long title.

left.text: The left column carries the situation: what happened, when it happened and who noticed first. It is long enough to wrap several times in a half-width column.

right.text: The right column carries the decision: what we will do next, who owns it and how we will know it worked. It wraps as often as the left one does.
